fact: Congolese delivery start-up Noki Noki closed a USD 3 million (XAF 1.8 billion) seed round led by Uma Ventures in June 2024, described as the first of its kind in the Republic of Congo.
title: La start-up Noki Noki lève 3 millions de dollars en seed pour révolutionner la livraison de proximité en Afrique
